description: PLANNER for what reports next: every $100B+ issuer's next date, options-implied move, 1y/2y/5y post-earnings reaction profile and forward P/E, PEG, P/B, plus a timeline of report clusters and gaps. Bare dates are in get_events_calendar.

from.description: First report date of a window, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, the report's New York date). Selects stock rows, timeline events and the clusters/gaps overlapping the window. Without from/to (and without tickers) the timeline covers the next 14 days.

include_drift.description: Include each window's PEAD drift aggregate (5/20/60-session post-announcement drift, split all / beat / miss), on every row and on the `cohort` — every $100B+ name pooled, which answers a group question in one call. Roughly triples the size of `windows`. Default false.

include_history.description: Include each stock's per-quarter report table (up to ~20 quarters), each row with its post-report drift. Default false.

min_market_cap.description: USD market-cap floor applied to stock rows AND timeline events. Default 1e11 ($100B — the profile universe, i.e. every name that has a reaction profile). Pass 1e10 for every $10B+ reporter on the timeline; asks under 1e10 clamp to 1e10 (nothing smaller is swept). Rows removed are counted in `filtered`.

tickers.description: Comma-separated tickers to keep (stock rows AND timeline events; bypasses min_market_cap), e.g. 'MSFT,KO,AMZN'. Up to 5 selected names without a daily implied move are priced on demand into `impliedMoves`. Omit for the whole profile universe.

to.description: Last report date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). If the window holds more events than one result carries, `window.to` comes back earlier: ask again from the next day.

top.description: Max stock rows returned (soonest report first). Default 20 (5 when include_history is set without a tickers filter); rows are also held to ~30k chars, so a large top returns fewer. The cut is recorded in `truncated`. Timeline clusters and gaps cover the whole profile universe.

name: get_earnings_hopper
